verdict.rationale: Honeybadger supports rule-like automation via Alarms (BadgerQL query + threshold triggers alerts) and anomaly detection, plus built-in automatic actions like auto-resolving errors on deploy; Slack/PagerDuty integrations let triggered alerts drive further actions (resolve/reopen, paging). This covers event-triggered automation but is limited to alerting/resolution rules rather than a general-purpose custom action/rule engine (e.g., no evidence of arbitrary webhook-based 'if X then run Y' workflows). Missing for 10: a documented general rules/workflow engine allowing arbitrary custom actions beyond alerting and deploy-based resolution, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this automation depth.
